title: Encoding and Propagation of Grammatical Number in Large Language Models
summary: Sparse autoencoders trained on Pythia-70M identified features associated with plural subjects and verb generation; intervening on those features changed number agreement in model outputs. Similar patterns were reported for Gemma-2-2B and Llama-3.1-8B, for the tested English constructions.
ai_technology: Sparse autoencoders and activation interventions in language models

evidence.tested: Sparse autoencoders trained on Pythia-70M identified features associated with plural subjects and verb generation; intervening on those features changed number agreement in model outputs. Similar patterns were reported for Gemma-2-2B and Llama-3.1-8B, for the tested English constructions.
evidence.unknown: The study evaluates the reported models and datasets only; broader generalization and real-world deployment outcomes were not established.
